d: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney brings a Donald Trump impersonator on stage at Ottawa's Parliamentary Press Gallery Dinner, triggering laughter with a hilarious roast of the US President. Comedian Mark Critch mimics Trump's signature handshake, mannerisms and comments on people's appearances, telling Carney: “He's got a great ass!” The performance also mocks Trump's threats to make Canada the 51st US state, his trade war with Ottawa and his unpredictable negotiating style.
